_comment: The only repos an image may be built for. Dependencies from anything not listed here are never installed. Each entry pins a commit: a moving branch would silently change every challenge's line numbers. `language` selects both the LanguageAdapter (bugforge/languages/) and the Dockerfile; `package` is the import package coverage measures for Python and the module root for Go. Root-layout packages only -- see the layout check in each Dockerfile.

repos.name: golang-jwt__jwt
repos._why: v5.3.0. Zero external module dependencies, no cgo, no network in any test, 53 tests green in ~4s, MIT licensed. Parsing and validation give the call depth a debugging challenge needs, which a flat conversion library would not.
